title: Draw bars from values
summary: A bar chart uses height to show a number.
introduction: A bar chart uses height to show a number. Your task: Change the middle value and predict its height.
learningObjectives: Change the middle value and predict its height.
Explain the example for draw bars from values

blocks.text: A bar chart uses height to show a number. SVG y positions grow downward, so a taller bar needs a smaller top y value.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

blocks.title: Draw bars from values

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `scaleLinear` maps numeric input values from its domain into output positions in its range.
`join` creates, updates and removes selected elements to match the bound data.

blocks.text: The bars grow upward from y=180 for values 30, 60 and 90.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not use the scaled y coordinate as the bar height. Subtract it from the baseline.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the middle value and predict its height.
